_comment: Default config for Overnight Studio. The LIVE copy at /home/studio/config.json is authoritative and mutable (level + bandit state live in sqlite). deploy.sh never overwrites an existing live config.

public._comment: Served at the root of studio.johnwatkinscodes.work via the cloudflared 'box' tunnel (ingress -> nginx :80). base='' => gallery at /, builds at /s/<slug>/. Covered by the existing one-level *.johnwatkinscodes.work cert.

cadence._comment: Energy budget per weekday. Sunday is retro (no build). Saturday is the heavy games night.

levels._comment: Level ladder. Studio can only climb through IMPLEMENTED levels; at the ceiling it writes an upgrade proposal for John instead of self-promoting.

1.name: single-toy
1.desc: One self-contained index.html — an art toy, a written article, or a micro-site. No build step.

2.name: interactive
2.desc: Multi-screen or stateful interaction; may split into a few JS modules.

3.name: small-game
3.desc: A playable small game with a loop, score, and restart. Saturday territory.

models._comment: Candidate models per role. The per-kind bandit explores/exploits among these; critic is chosen to differ from the builder. Builders COMPETE per kind (claude, gemini, codex) so each content type routes to whoever scores best. code-critic lists all so a non-builder is always available.

model_cost._comment: Relative $/call hint. The bandit reward is quality-per-cost, so it prefers a model that's ~as good but cheaper, and only reaches for a pricier one when clearly better. Seed from reputable benchmarks/pricing.

retro.promote_if: all runs shipped AND peak budget < 0.70 AND zero failures over the week
